biography.concept: Usher and doorkeeper of the cinema-vigil family — Qliph-Scarred (Chthonic) Bulwark, Path of the Mountain, T III, Initiation 13 (Act 3).
biography.notes: Fendeddiir holds the door. Something older than Hell tried to keep Fendeddiir once and failed, and what walked back up carries the staircase in its legs and a velvet rope in its hands. Fendeddiir enforces the Solemn Removal of Chewing Gum, seats the vigil, and stands between the family and anything that comes out of the Vault without a ticket. Fendeddiir has never seen a film all the way through. Someone has to watch the door.

description.value:
Qliph-Scarred. You walked out of a place that should have unmade you. The hollows and fractures in your soul never fully closed, and the world can feel the pressure leaking out.

Qliph-Scarred Traits

  • Creature Type. Humanoid (Qliph-Scarred).

  • Size. You are Medium.

  • Speed. Your walking speed is 6 squares

  • attributes. Your background determines your attribute increases; Qliph-Scarred does not grant any attribute bonuses.

Qliph-Scarred Core. At character creation you gain What Walked Out (Shadow Resilience, Qliphothic Saturation, Hunger Mask, Shadow-Wake). Your heritage adds its own traits and Tier powers at Initiation 1, 5, 11 and 17.

description.value:
“There is a place older than Hell. You remember being there. It remembers you back.”

Qliph-Scarred (Chthonic). Your scar is a root. The unmaking that almost took you went down, not sideways — into strata of reality older than the gods that eventually got around to naming them. You walked out up through something that shouldn’t have had a staircase. Parts of that staircase are still in your legs.

Traits

  • Creature Type. Humanoid (Qliph-Scarred).

  • Size. Medium.

  • Movement. 6 squares walking.

  • Lineage Lean. Qliph-Scarred does not grant fixed attribute bonuses; your background handles increases. Your heritage leans toward Body in fiction and through Tier powers.

Qliph-Scarred Core: What Walked Out

Shared across all Qliph-Scarred heritages. Granted at character creation via the base ancestry item.

  • Shadow Resilience. You have resistance to qliphothic damage. You reroll the lowest die on Body checks against effects that would drain, wither, or corrupt your body.

  • Qliphothic Saturation. Once per scene, when you fail a Soul check, you may reroll it — but your scene's Darkness-gain count increases by 1. The scar pays for what the scar saves.

  • Hunger Mask. You can suppress a bodily need (hunger, thirst, sleep, breath) for up to 24 hours by deciding to; you do not suffer its penalties during that window. At the end of the 24 hours, all deferred needs strike you at once, each as a separate Stress-class consequence.

  • Shadow-Wake. Creatures with qliphothic attunement (demons, corrupt sephirot, Radiation-warped entities) can sense you at 12 squares and know you have been marked. They may not know how to read the mark.

Chthonic Traits

  • Old-Dark Vision. You have low-light vision to 12 squares, and in darkness you see in color rather than greyscale. You have been in a dark older than eyes, and it taught you how.

  • Root-Bound. Once per Soma Break, you may spend 10 minutes in physical contact with uncut earth or unworked stone. Until your next Soma Break, you gain a +1 rank bonus on all Body checks. The depth is lending you some of itself.

Domain Edge

  • Domain Edge. Your Domain gains +20 Violence marks and +20 Faith marks at campaign start.

⟁ Per-Use Ability — Qliphothic Saturation Recovery: 1/scene  ·  Action: Free  ·  Use: Click this feature on your sheet to invoke. Reroll a failed Soul check. Cost: scene's Darkness-gain count goes up by 1.

description.value:
"Set your feet. The line forms on you."

The Bulwark is the wall — and the wall runs on Surge, like everyone, but yours arrives the hard way: every time you take Integrity damage you bank +1 Surge (max +2/round (+3 with Polarity Mastery, Mountain)). You eat the blow and turn it into the power to anchor, erupt, or hold. At zero Surge you still stand in the way; soak one hit and your turn opens up.

The Fortress (spent via Surge — Bulwark only)

  • Brace Wall (1) — you and adjacent allies gain DR equal to Tier this round.

  • Bulwark Stance (6) — adjacent allies share your defenses until your next turn.

  • Anchor (5) — you and one ally become immune to forced movement and crowd-control until next round.

  • Mass Aegis (8) — allies within Tier squares gain +Tier to every defense this round.

  • Sanctum (9) — immune to one damage type for a round.

  • Mythic Stand (10) — invulnerable until the start of your next turn.

These were always the Bulwark's birthright; they no longer leak into everyone else's menu. The old Frame and Ruin tricks are Surge spends too — Absorb (1), Push (1), Shockwave Footing (2), Catastrophic Entry (3), Siege Works (2) and Ruin to Renewal (3) — and your Path adds three more of its own.

"You belong here now. Argue with the mountain."

Doctrine: Durability, refusal, rootedness — immovable, load-bearing, patient.

The Mountain makes the scene bounce off you. Your Surge spends are the geometry of refusal: roots that share their footing, a flat "no" to the next thing done to you or yours, and a bastion the whole line forms behind.

Path (spent via Surge)

  • Root (1) — you and adjacent allies gain DR equal to Tier and cannot be forcibly moved.
  • Deny (2) — you or an ally becomes immune to forced-movement/CC and gains DR this round.
  • Bastion (5) — allies within Tier squares gain DR equal to Tier; you cannot be moved.

system.source: Bad Eden Bulwark + Shadow Courier v1.0 (RFI-native rules)

description.value:
Signature move. Once a scene, you choose which kind of inevitability you are.

Anchor or Advance — 1/scene (recovers on Soma Break). As part of any action on your turn, declare a stance. The chosen stance lasts until the end of your next turn:

  • Anchor. You cannot be moved against your will by any effect short of a Heroic-DC (22) push from a creature of your size or larger. Forced movement, knockback, teleportation targeting you, banishment, and dimensional swap effects all fail.

  • Advance. You cannot be prevented from reaching a destination you declare on the same action. Difficult terrain, conditions that halve speed, reaction strikes, and zone-of-control effects do not stop your movement toward that point. You may still take damage along the way.

Doctrine features at L5+ extend or modify which stance you favor.

system.source: Bad Eden Bulwark + Shadow Courier v1.0 (RFI-native rules)

description.value:
Your Path's Surge generation learns a second voice.

At Bulwark Initiation 11, apply the rule for your chosen Path:

  • Path of the Avalanche. Bank +1 Surge when you land a melee strike whose dice show an 8 or higher before explosions. Once per round.

  • Path of the Mountain. Your eat-the-blow cap rises from +2 to +3 Surge a round.

  • Path of the Cataclyst. When you make a defensive and an offensive Surge spend in the same round, in either order, bank +1 Surge. Once per round.

system.source: Bad Eden Bulwark + Shadow Courier v1.0 (RFI-native rules)

description.value:
The world has two ways of saying no to change. You learn one of them today.

On gaining Bulwark Initiation 1 you receive:

  • Skill rank +1 in Athletics (Violence).

  • Skill rank +1 in Melee and Plating.

  • +30 Violence marks to your Domain's cap, and 20 marks of free siege works folded into the buffer every time your Domain opens or joins a Siege.

  • You bank Surge by eating the blow: +1 Surge each time you take Integrity damage (max +2 a round). Spend it from the ◆ Surge menu.

Your Path's L1 feature shapes how you bank it.

system.source: Bad Eden Bulwark + Shadow Courier v1.0 (RFI-native rules)

description.value:
Nothing that stands can be moved. Your inevitability is the kind that absorbs.

Mode: Immovable Object / drift: Away.

You bank Surge by absorbing damage rather than by breaking things: each Integrity hit you take banks +1 Surge (max +2 a round, +3 once Polarity Mastery arrives).

system.requirements: Path of the Mountain, Bulwark Initiation 1

description.value:
You decide which side of you is the wall.

Reaction. When a creature within 1 square of you attempts to move past you (toward a square that would put you between it and where it came from), you may spend 1 Surge as a reaction. Its movement simply ends in its current square — no attack roll, no defense check. It has not yet spent the movement and may retreat or take a different path next turn.

Limit: once per target per encounter. Use the ▶ button with the creature targeted.

system.requirements: Path of the Mountain, Bulwark Initiation 5

system.source: Bad Eden Bulwark + Shadow Courier v1.0 (RFI-native rules)

description.value:
Time itself counts as ground you have claimed.

You cannot be moved from a space you have occupied for at least one full round, except by a single damage instance equal to or greater than your current Integrity value. This denial covers, but is not limited to:

  • Forced movement of any kind (push, pull, slide, throw)

  • Teleportation effects targeting you

  • Banishment, dimensional swap, and plane-shift effects

  • Knockback from area-of-effect damage

  • Grapple and drag attempts

You may end the Hold voluntarily as a free action on your turn. After moving voluntarily, you must occupy a new space for one full round before the Hold protects you again.

system.requirements: Path of the Mountain, Bulwark Initiation 9

system.source: Bad Eden Bulwark + Shadow Courier v1.0 (RFI-native rules)

description.value:
Your body has mass that is not strictly physical.

Three constant effects:

  • Ranged attacks against you roll 3d10 keep lowest 2 instead of the standard 2d10 attack pool (no Surge banking on dropped dice).

  • Manifestations and effects that require you to move in order to resolve (forced-charge compulsions, spatial-displacement triggers, ritual circles dependent on your motion) fail outright. The caster's expenditure is consumed.

  • Area-of-effect damage that allows a defense check is reduced by your Bulwark Initiation in points even on a failed check, before resistances apply.

Slow approach. A creature attempting to advance toward you across open ground (≥ 6 squares of unobstructed path) must succeed on a Soul defense checks against DC 15 + your Initiation tier. On a failure, the creature uses its entire turn to advance only its normal Move distance — it cannot sprint, charge, or take additional movement actions that turn.

system.requirements: Path of the Mountain, Bulwark Initiation 13

The world pushes. You remain.

Rules

⚙ Reroll-lowest on checks and defense checks; the push / pull / prone / Shaken / charm gate is read by the GM.

Grim Persistence

You are difficult to kill because you do not stop.

Rules

Your Integrity maximum increases by an amount equal to twice your level. Additionally, once per Soma Break, when you are reduced to 0 Integrity but not killed outright, you may remain at 1 Integrity instead.

⚙ Integrity max +2 × level applies automatically; the hold-at-1 fires by itself, once per Soma Break.

A black-bladed reaver, etched with the wielder's true name. Speaks softly when drawn. Refuses any other grip.

⚙️ Mechanical Effects

  • Faculty: Violence
  • Attack: Melee (Violence)
  • Reach: Melee

item.signature: The hex remembers what the steel would forget.
item.lore:
Heavy plate hand-engraved with hex-warding glyphs over every joint and seam. Cold-iron core, anchorstone fittings.

Slows the wearer; unmoves them. The hex grounds blunt force; the carving turns cursed-energy aside.
